decision_conditions: The retrospective boundary treatment by reason of its height and design, appear incongruous and form an unacceptably dominant and visually intrusive feature within the street, harmful to the appearance of the street scene and detracting from the character of the surrounding area. As such, the boundary treatment is considered to be contrary to Policy 26 of the Havering Local Plan 2021 and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, it was necessary to issue a decision as close to the statutory timeframe as possible as opposed to seeking amendments which would have significantly delayed the application.
description: Retrospective application for retention of front boundary treatment.
